main_text.head: LI. EPITOME Historiæ & Chronologiæ sacræ.5
Primum interuallum, à creatione mundi ad diluuium.
main_text.p: An.M. I.In principio temporis Deus creauit cœlum & terram, & vniuersum exercitū illorum. Gen. 1. & 2. Fuit autem istud principium veris: quia hæc est naturalissima & perfectissima anni ratio, ut incipiat à vere. Quæ etiam causa est, quòd Deus annum sacrum inchoauit à vere, politi-15cum ab autumno. Sanè perfectissimam anni rationem in sacris obtinuisse nemini debet esse dubium.10
main_text.l: 622. | Enoch, filius Iared, nascitur. Gen.5.v.18. Hic fuit se-25ptimus ab Adam. Iudæ v.14.
987. | Enoch assumitur viuus in cœlum. Gen.5.v.24.25.30
1056. | Noah, decimus ab Adam, nascitur ex Lamecho.

page.notes: Line numbers 5 to 35 in the right margin are kept as margin notes beside the lines they stand against. A small mark after "esse" at the right margin is not text and is left out. Column rules and the "An.M." labels are layout only. Text is clear throughout; no illegible words. Long s is written as s, so "fuit se-ptimus" appears with a printed hyphen. Spelling of u/v and i/j normalised per rule 5. Printed "creauit", "inchoauit" and "vniuersum" are normalised to "creavit", "inchoavit" and "universum" in the text as per the u/v rule; "exercitū" keeps the macron.
